payload.title: Projection-author ergonomics helpers
payload.description: The specific projections are app logic, but the micro-ergonomics every projection author re-derives are generic: a typed list<T>(ctx, type) over ctx.store.listObjects, a single(key, value) change-set helper, and the source-type bootstrap set used at boot. Reference impl: ~/dev/aquariusyacht/apps/backend/src/projections/index.ts. Ship these as small exported helpers alongside the projection API (FR-109/FR-115). Lowest priority — pure DX sugar.
